fact: On 16 October 2026 the chair of the House communications committee said the Justice Ministry had drafted over 80% of a bill regulating AI use, to go to the Cabinet and then the committee, with deepfakes and AI misuse a legislative priority.
title: الانتهاء من 80% من مواده.. مصر تمهد لبيئة استثمارية رقمية آمنة بأول قانون للذكاء الاصطناعي قريبًا
